chapters.title: Krishna as the Swan — Teachings to the Sages

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
गुणेष्वसक्तधीः पुंसां गुणेषु प्रतिषिद्ध्यते ।
गुणाश्च प्रकृतेर्विद्धि नात्मनस्ते मयोदिताः ॥
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord said: For one whose mind is unattached to the material qualities, the influence of those qualities is checked. Know that the gunas belong to material nature, not to the Self — this is My teaching.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वं रजस् तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः ।
येन बद्धो भवेत् जीवः तैर्मुक्तो भवति प्रभुः ॥
verses.translation: Sattva, rajas, and tamas — these are the qualities born of material nature. By these, the living being becomes bound; freed from them, one becomes a master.
